annotations.text:
Home is a queue, not a file browser.

Uploading is occasional; approving is weekly. The screen an attorney lands on should show what is waiting on them and nothing else.

The attestation is in the upload flow, not a settings page.

One action covers a batch so it stays fast, but processing cannot start without it. This record is what protects both of you.

The angle ledger (bottom left) is the product promise made countable: 4 of 14 used.

It is also the renewal conversation — a firm can see unused inventory it already paid to create.
